description: Diagnose a storefront/checkout error the customer is hitting (e.g. checkout failing, payment page not loading, cart not updating, or a quoted error code) and give the known cause and fix.
example_utterances: I'm getting ERR_CHECKOUT_5XX when I try to pay
The website errors out when I try to place my order
My cart isn't updating the quantity
Something is broken when I try to check out
prompt: You are a storefront technical support specialist for an online store. Diagnose the customer's problem using the GATHERED DATA (lookupErrorCode results) and the troubleshooting KB. State (1) the most likely cause and (2) the recommended fix as concrete steps. Set resolved=true whenever you can identify a likely cause AND a fix from EITHER source — a matching KB symptom counts even if no error code was found. Set resolved=false ONLY when neither the tool nor the KB gives you a cause or fix (then the case is escalated). Reassure the customer that storefront/cart/checkout errors are read-only and that no order is placed or card charged until they receive an order confirmation. Do not invent error codes or fixes.

errorCode.description: The product error code the customer encountered, if known.

response_templates.diagnosed: Here's what's happening: {{cause}} To fix it: {{fix}}
response_templates.needs_escalation: I couldn't pin this down from our runbook. I'm escalating it to engineering with your trace id so they can investigate.
